column1: # Detection models fetched by scripts/fetch_models.sh, one per line.
# Deliberately not committed to this repository. OVCS is MIT licensed;
# YOLOv8's weights are Ultralytics AGPL-3.0, and the two do not compose
# in that direction — MIT tells downstream users they may use this
# without source-disclosure obligations, which AGPL does not permit
# anyone to grant. Distributing the weights here would make a promise
# the licence cannot keep. Fetching them is the operator's choice, on
# the operator's terms.
# See the Detection models section of docs/vision/README.md for the
# licensing note in full, including the permissively licensed models.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   destination (relative to the repo root)
#   sha256
#   licence
#   url
#   member (optional): the url is a zip, the model is this member of it,
#     and the sha256 is the member's
# The sha256 is not optional. A binary fetched over the network with no
# integrity check is a worse position than a committed one, not a
# better one.
# The default. NanoDet-RepVGG is Apache-2.0, so nothing about it
# conflicts with this repository's MIT licence, and it needs no code
# change: it carries the same in-graph NMS net flow as YOLOv8
# (HAILO_NET_FLOW_YOLOV8_NMS), and `hailo_detect` derives the input
# size and class count from the HEF at runtime.
vehicles/ovcs_mini/priv/models/nanodet_repvgg.hef
# Kept selectable for anyone who holds an Ultralytics licence, and
# because its accuracy at this resolution is the measured baseline.
# Set OVCS_HAILO_MODEL=yolov8n to use it.
vehicles/ovcs_mini/priv/models/yolov8n.hef
